script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: The deadline and oven joke makes light of a scene involving crucified bodies.
The joke about clocking out is flippant in a scene about crucifixion.
“Count twice, bake once” makes light of the soldiers breaking the men's legs.
“Two men, two sets, nobody skipped” treats the violence flippantly.
The passage does not say Pilate was busy elsewhere.
The verse says why these things happened, not that Scripture is why the writer is pointing them out.
The passage does not say Pilate had a lot going on.
“A nervous ask” attributes a feeling to Joseph without marking it as Papa Dorin's guess.
The pricey-tip joke is flippant in an explanation about Jesus' burial and the soldiers at the cross.
The reference supports Jesus calling Lazarus out of the tomb, but not the statement that Lazarus was His friend. John 11:11 supports that detail.
“Wrong stop” uses a prohibited word about the baker's answer.
